answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bridge bond on the horizon ledger and buys one bridge crossing per epoch in an auction. A crossing yields a signed sonnet receipt naming task, payer, and seal, posted on the bridge ledger for recompute. The fee starts at 15 credits; the kth identity pays 15+4(k-1), so the 1,000th pays 4,011 and 1,000 clones pay 2,013,000 plus 60,000 locked. An honest identity pays 60 plus 15 once and recovers the bond after a clean epoch. A rented-crossing ring fails because one seal key cannot sign two receipts: the ledger rejects the second crossing and burns both bonds.
